newsitem.title: USA: Proxymed to sell up to $7.7 mln of stock.
newsitem.headline: Proxymed to sell up to $7.7 mln of stock.

text.p: ProxyMed Inc said on Thursday it had agreed to sell between 600,000 and 700,000 shares of its common stock to Bellingham Industries Inc, for proceeds of up to $7.7 million.
ProxyMed said the shares will sell for $11.00 per share, and will close between June 20 and June 30 depending upon how many shares are sold.
Bellingham will own up to 1,970,000 shares as a result of the sale, or 17.8 percent of ProxyMed's outstanding common.

"With these additional funds, ProxyMed is in a stronger position to execute its strategy of investing in development and sales of its unique healthcare information technology products and services, and pursue any other acquisitions which we deem to be synergistic," said Bennett Marks, executive vice president of finance at ProxyMed.
ProxyMed was up 3/8 at 10-1/4 in afternoon trade on Nasdaq.
